items.html: And the reason is that the letters Yod-Hei are Hochma and Bina, as is known, for the Daat is their offspring, which decides between them. And since the two letters Yod-Hei, which indicate Hochma and Bina, were revealed, that is sufficient. And this also indicates what was stated at first: that the essence of what is revealed from the aspect of the Mochin at the time of nursing is Hochma and Bina alone, for the Daat is only revealed in an inclusive manner alone, as above.
